title: Washing a MinION Flowcell
author: Kirstyn Brunker
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bddzi276

steps.title: Prepare Wash Solution A
steps.instruction: Place the tube of Wash Solution A on ice. Mix only by gently inverting the tube; do not vortex, as DNase I is sensitive to physical denaturation.

steps.title: Prepare Wash Solution B
steps.instruction: Thaw one tube of Wash Solution B at room temperature, mix thoroughly by vortexing, spin down briefly, and place on ice.

steps.title: Prepare Wash Mix
steps.instruction: In a clean 1.5 ml Eppendorf DNA LoBind tube, combine 20 µL of Wash Solution A and 380 µL of Wash Solution B. Mix well by pipetting and place on ice; do not vortex.

steps.title: Prepare Flow Cell for Washing
steps.instruction: Stop or pause the sequencing experiment in MinKNOW (if currently sequencing) and leave the flow cell in the device.

substeps.instruction: Ensure the priming port cover and SpotON sample port cover are closed.
Remove all fluid from the waste channel using a P1000 pipette.

steps.title: Expose Priming Port
steps.instruction: Rotate the flow cell priming port cover clockwise 90° to make the priming port visible.

steps.title: Remove Air from Priming Port
steps.instruction: Check for air between the priming port and the sensor array. If air is present, remove it using a P1000 pipette.

substeps.instruction: Set a P1000 pipette to 200 µl.
Insert the tip into the priming port, holding the pipette perpendicular to the flowcell.
Turn the wheel anti-clockwise until the dial shows 220-230 µl, or until a small volume of buffer/liquid enters the pipette tip (do not remove too much liquid).
Visually verify that there is continuous buffer from the priming port across the sensor array.

steps.title: Load Wash Mix
steps.instruction: Load 400 µl of the prepared Wash Mix into the flow cell via the priming port, avoiding the introduction of air.

substeps.instruction: Dispense the liquid as slowly as possible, potentially by turning the pipette dial clockwise to dispense.

steps.title: Incubate and Monitor
steps.instruction: Close the priming port and wait for 30 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Optionally monitor digestion by starting or resuming a run in MinKNOW to observe the number of pores in strand dropping to zero and the number of single pores increasing.
